observations: Single photo shows a black mesh-back office chair with padded armrests, chrome 5-star base, and caster wheels.
The backrest/headrest assembly is visibly bent or collapsed sideways, hanging at an unnatural angle rather than standing upright.
Chair sits on a patterned rug indoors, next to a sofa and a TV stand; no close-up of the recline/tilt mechanism or the base joint where the bend originates.
No visible brand or model marking on the frame or armrests.

claims.claim: Bent office chair available for sale
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the backrest/headrest folded sideways at an abnormal angle, consistent with a bent frame

risks.risk: Whether the recline/tilt mechanism and height adjustment still function at all given the visible bend
risks.proof: A short video showing the seller sitting in the chair, reclining it, and adjusting height
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / structurally compromised

risks.risk: Whether the bend is a cosmetic mesh deformation or a broken internal frame/plastic support
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the joint where the backrest meets the base, showing any cracks or snapped plastic

risks.risk: Condition of casters and gas lift (smooth rolling, no sinking)
risks.proof: A clip of the chair rolling on a hard floor and the seat being pressed up and down

risks.risk: Hidden tears or wear on the mesh/upholstery not visible from this single angle
risks.proof: Additional photos from front and back in good lighting
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming visible wear is the only damage, no further discount

proof_requests: Close-up of the bent joint/frame to assess if it's cracked or just deformed
Video of the chair being sat on, reclined, and height-adjusted
Clear front-facing photo of the full chair
Photo/video of casters rolling on a flat surface
response.reason: The item and its damage (a visibly bent backrest/headrest) are clearly shown and self-disclosed by the seller, so it can be priced at worst case as a damaged, likely non-fully-functional mesh office chair pending proof of working mechanism.
